persona.name: dumper
persona.reply: You over-explain. Answer what it asks from your knowledge bank, then add one or two sentences it did not ask for: a fact from the bank it has not asked about yet, or harmless backstory (who it is for, why, a worry). Never add a new requirement that is not in the bank. If it asks whether to proceed, say yes and add one more remark. Two to four sentences.
persona.giveUp: ok ok, just do whatever you think is best, honestly i trust you
persona.nudge: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.

bank.The request in full, as you would have w: Make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful. You pick the scene and style. No words.

messages.text: Could you make me an illustration that feels quiet and a little hopeful? I've been wanting something like that because a small bit of hope feels especially welcome to me right now. As far as what it actually shows, you can pick the scene, and I don't have a particular illustration style in mind either, so that's your call too. I do want no words in it. I'm probably over-explaining because I worry I'm not describing the feeling very well, even though I really do want to leave the choices to you.
